• East Bengal FC vs Sporting Club Delhi || Match Content || Highlights || Match 29 || 20-Nov-2026 || English ||
Twice behind, twice level! Watch the big moments as East Bengal FC and Sporting Club Delhi drew 2-2 at the Salt Lake Stadium in the MG Indian Super League 2026-27.
Carlos Fortes and Ashutosh Mehta both put Delhi in front. Each time, Dani Ramírez set up the reply: first for Edmund Lalrindika before half-time, and then for Aké Arnaud Loba with seven minutes left. East Bengal finished with 22 shots to Delhi’s eight.
